reason: I would not hand my default viewer to an unknown .exe from one developer, version 0.4.1, no word on signing or source. FastStone already does what I need and I know it.
why_switch_or_not: Speed numbers are nice, but my screenshots and PNG exports already open fast enough in FastStone, so I gain little. This thing has a gallery, editor, 3D, video, audio, scanner importer, and I want a viewer that only views. I'd also have to tick every format myself in Windows Settings, and I don't know if it has the full-screen mode and browser I use daily.
current_app_pros: FastStone's full-screen mode with the hidden edge menus, the file browser, and the simple editor for crop/resize/sharpen. It handles my RAW+JPG folders and I can cull quickly. It is stable and I have used it for years.
current_app_pains: Rapid next/back on big folders is a bit sluggish, but it doesn't really bother me. Nothing serious.
objection: Is an unknown .exe from one person safe? Nothing says it is signed or open source, and it does far more than viewing, so there is more to go wrong.
would_change_my_mind: A signed installer, public source code or a clean independent scan, and a clearly pure-viewer mode with the same full-screen behaviour as FastStone.
